name: hacklm-memory
description: Persistent memory layer for VS Code Copilot — learn from interactions, retain insights, improve over time

languageModelTools.name: hacklm-memory_storeMemory
languageModelTools.userDescription: Save a durable insight about this project for future sessions.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Store a durable insight about this project that would help in future sessions. Only store things that will matter next week. ALWAYS call queryMemory first to avoid duplicates. Always provide a slug (kebab-case topic key, e.g. 'console-logs'). Same slug = update, not duplicate. Categories: Instruction (how to behave), Quirk (project-specific weirdness), Preference (style/design choices), Decision (architectural commitments), Security (rules that must never be broken).

content.description: The insight to store. Should be clear, actionable, and durable. Keep it to one concise line.

slug.description: A short kebab-case topic identifier (e.g. 'console-logs', 'async-style'). Same slug in the same category = overwrite, not duplicate.

languageModelTools.name: hacklm-memory_queryMemory
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search stored memories for relevant principles, preferences, and decisions.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search stored memories for relevant principles, preferences, best practices, and decisions. Call this before answering questions about architecture, conventions, style, or any topic where prior context would help. Returns the most relevant entries ranked by keyword match and recency.

query.description: Search query — keywords or a natural language question

category.description: Optional: filter to a specific category

languageModelTools.name: hacklm-memory_harvestMemory
languageModelTools.userDescription: Automatically capture durable learnings at the end of a chat turn.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Call at the end of every response to capture durable learnings from this turn. Provide an array of findings worth persisting across sessions. Skip entirely if you already called storeMemory this turn. Only include things that will matter next week — skip anything session-specific, obvious, or already known.

findings.description: Durable learnings to persist from this turn.

slug.description: Optional kebab-case topic key. Same slug = update, not duplicate.

hacklm-memory.lmFamily.description: Language model family to use for LLM-assisted operations (e.g. 'gpt-5-mini', 'gpt-4o', 'claude-sonnet')

hacklm-memory.autoCleanupFrequency.description: Run cleanup automatically after this many store_memory calls

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Instruction.description: Max memories to keep in Instruction category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Quirk.description: Max memories to keep in Quirk category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Preference.description: Max memories to keep in Preference category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Decision.description: Max memories to keep in Decision category

hacklm-memory.categoryLimit.Security.description: Max memories to keep in Security category

hacklm-memory.autoApproveStore.description: Skip the confirmation prompt when saving to memory (store_memory). Enable only if you trust the agent's judgment.
